mapper.select: SELECT CASE order_status WHEN 1 THEN '待付款' WHEN 2 THEN '已付款' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM order_main WHERE 1=1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND order_status = #{orderStatus} GROUP BY order_status

SELECT CASE pay_type WHEN 1 THEN '微信' WHEN 2 THEN '支付宝' WHEN 3 THEN '现金' WHEN 4 THEN '刷卡' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM order_main WHERE 1=1 AND pay_time >= #{startTime} AND pay_time <= #{endTime} AND pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY pay_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, SUM(actual_pay) AS value FROM order_main WHERE 1=1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name

SELECT CASE role_type WHEN 'admin' THEN '系统管理员' WHEN 'manager' THEN '店长' WHEN 'clerk' THEN '店员' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_info WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} GROUP BY role_type

SELECT d.dish_name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS value FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN order_main om ON oi.order_id = om.id LEFT JOIN dish_info d ON oi.dish_id = d.id WHERE 1=1 AND om.store_id = #{storeId} AND om.create_time >= #{startTime} AND om.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY d.dish_name

SELECT CASE order_status WHEN 1 THEN '待付款' WHEN 2 THEN '已付款' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM order_main WHERE 1=1 AND store_id = #{storeId} AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY order_status
SELECT m.real_name AS name, m.consume_amount AS value FROM member_info m WHERE 1=1 AND m.register_store_id = #{registerStoreId} AND m.is_vip = #{isVip} ORDER BY m.consume_amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(s.store_name, '未知门店') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(om.actual_pay), 0) AS value FROM sys_store s LEFT JOIN order_main om ON s.id = om.store_id WHERE 1=1
AND (om.create_time IS NULL OR om.create_time >= #{startTime})
AND (om.create_time IS NULL OR om.create_time <= #{endTime})
GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(s.store_name, '未知门店'), '-', CASE om.order_status WHEN 1 THEN '待付款' WHEN 2 THEN '已付款' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_store s LEFT JOIN order_main om ON s.id = om.store_id WHERE 1=1
AND (om.create_time IS NULL OR om.create_time >= #{startTime})
AND (om.create_time IS NULL OR om.create_time <= #{endTime})
GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, om.order_status HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY s.store_name, om.order_status
